en: Vintage sepia/green-tinted postcard with three photographic views: at the top a railway station building with an attached or adjacent hotel; in the middle a small ornate building labeled as a telephone station; at the bottom a long brick building identified as the public elementary school. The captions are printed in Swedish, and at the bottom the locality name 'Teckomatorp' is given.
